G0883.name: Achaicus
G0883.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G0883.brief: A Corinthian Christian who visited Paul.
G0883.short: Achaicus, along with Stephanas and Fortunatus, visited Paul from Corinth.

G0885.name: Achim
G0885.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G0885.brief: Ancestor of Jesus, son of Zadok (or 'Sadoc')
G0885.short: Achim was an ancestor of Jesus Christ, mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus in the Gospel of Matthew.

G0828.name: Augustus
G0828.desc: Emperor living at the time of the New Testament
G0828.brief: Roman emperor during the birth of Jesus
G0828.short: Augustus, also known as Caesar, was the Roman emperor during the time of Jesus' birth and early life (<ref="Luk.2.1; 3:1; Act.25.21, 25; 27:1">Luk.2.1; 3:1; Act.25.21, 25; 27:1</ref>).

G0882.name: Achaia
G0882.brief: A Roman province in southern Greece, including Corinth.
G0882.short: Achaia, a Roman province covering much of Greece, with Corinth as its capital.

G0825.name: Attalia
G0825.brief: Seaport in Pamphylia visited by Paul and Barnabas.
G0825.short: Attalia, a seaport in Pamphylia, was visited by Paul and Barnabas. (<ref="Act.14.25">Act.14.25</ref>)
